children: IQSTEL announced a goal to reach a potential mobile audience of 40 million users and an illustrative 500,000 gross subscribers for IDILIO TV by end-2027.
Announced strategic partnership with IDILIO TV to use IQSTEL's operator channels for mobile-first microdrama distribution.
Targets a combined potential audience of ~40 million mobile users via carrier distribution by Q2 2027; not guaranteed subscribers.
Illustrative model: 1.25% penetration of 40M → ~500,000 gross subscribers by end of 2027; stated as illustrative, not guidance.
IDILIO TV backed by $5M seed round led by a16z Speedrun with multiple prominent investors and 2M+ downloads reported.
IQSTEL sees the initiative as part of EBITDA and margin expansion, leveraging telecom billing rails and operator relationships.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: IQSTEL launches IDILIO TV distribution targeting 40M mobile users and 500k subscribers
